question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are holding a white elephant gift exchange. At the start of the event, they are each holding a present of a different color: Alice has a black present, Bob has a green present, Claire has a white present, Dave has a silver present, Eve has a red present, Fred has a orange present, and Gertrude has a blue present.
As the event progresses, pairs of people swap gifts. First, Claire and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Eve and Alice swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Bob swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Fred swap their gifts. Then, Dave and Claire swap their gifts. Then, Claire and Dave swap their gifts. Finally, Eve and Bob swap their gifts. At the end of the event, Gertrude has the
Options:
(A) black present
(B) green present
(C) white present
(D) silver present
(E) red present
(F) orange present
(G) blue present
solution:
Present colors in holder order (Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude):
Initial: (black, green, white, silver, red, orange, blue)
1. Claire ↔ Alice: (white, green, black, silver, red, orange, blue)
2. Eve ↔ Alice: (red, green, black, silver, white, orange, blue)
3. Dave ↔ Bob: (red, silver, black, green, white, orange, blue)
4. Claire ↔ Fred: (red, silver, orange, green, white, black, blue)
5. Dave ↔ Claire: (red, silver, green, orange, white, black, blue)
6. Claire ↔ Dave: (red, silver, orange, green, white, black, blue)
7. Eve ↔ Bob: (red, white, orange, green, silver, black, blue)
Gertrude has the blue present, option (G).
Final answer: (G)
